card: Cleans up `#include` directives across selected source files in `src/` and enables strict Include What You Use (IWYU) enforcement for them in CI. The change eliminates reliance on transitive includes that otherwise trigger IWYU warnings. This was extracted as a prerequisite needed for fuzz test include cleanups in #36808.
evidence: PR description notes it was split out as a prerequisite for PR #36808 ('iwyu: Fix warnings in `src/test/fuzz` and treat them as errors').
problem: Certain source files in `src/` have missing or redundant includes that trigger IWYU warnings, preventing CI from enforcing clean headers on those modules and blocking cleanups in tests.

risk.why: Incorrect header additions or removals could lead to compilation failures on specific platforms or configurations.

scope_notes: Mechanical header adjustments across 20 files accompanied by CI enforcement list changes.
summary: Fixes include directives across several source modules in `src/` to satisfy Include What You Use (IWYU) checks, and enables IWYU error enforcement for those files in CI. Formats the top-level list of IWYU-enforced files to one per line to make future additions cleaner. Adds explicit includes to files that previously relied on transitive dependencies.
